Claude Unwrapped packages My AI Vocabulary and Search Filmstrip for Claude Desktop and Cowork.

Download context-gallery.zip and upload it through Customize → Skills, or add nealriley/claude-unwrapped as a plugin marketplace.

The skill generates a downloadable gallery from a supplied Claude export. Extract the gallery and open claude-unwrapped/index.html in Chrome. My AI Vocabulary can record its portrait canvas as video.

Automated verification covers archive import and packaging, offline gallery playback, and a portrait recording download. Screenshot capture depends on browser and network availability and reports its actual result.

Desktop acceptance is pending. This draft should be published after both skill ZIP installation and GitHub marketplace installation have been exercised in a live Claude Desktop account and their generated galleries opened successfully in Chrome.
